svg.title: Corridor for the Lajkonik sample route
svg.desc: The 243 km Lajkonik route buffered by 8 km and by 3 km, drawn from the real GPX with garmap's corridor code, next to the six steps that produce the clip polygon.
svg.text: all track segments and routes become one geometry
to an azimuthal-equidistant CRS centred on the route centroid
by --buffer, in metres on the ground (quad_segs=8)
splitter r654 mishandles holes; a loop is filled in
osmosis polygon format, read by splitter and pyhgtmap
At either buffer this loop closes over its own middle, so there is no hole to drop.
